mapper.select: SELECT ce.*, c.title as courseTitle, c.cover_image as coverImage FROM course_enroll ce JOIN course c ON ce.course_id = c.id WHERE ce.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ce.enroll_time DESC

SELECT ce.*, c.title as courseTitle, c.cover_image as coverImage, e.name as studentName, ce.is_completed as status FROM course_enroll ce JOIN course c ON ce.course_id = c.id JOIN sys_user e ON ce.user_id = e.id ORDER BY ce.enroll_time DESC
SELECT ce.*, c.title as courseTitle FROM course_enroll ce JOIN course c ON ce.course_id = c.id WHERE ce.user_id = #{userId} AND ce.course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_enroll SET progress = #{progress}, is_completed = #{isCompleted}, complete_time = #{completeTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE course_enroll SET is_completed = 1, complete_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_enroll WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
